decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already captures the $5 founder allocation, $5 Small Block pool allocation, and removal of Big Block from the primary-mint pool destinations.
Eliminating Big Block and reallocating primary-mint proceeds does not change the Transak provider, payment conversion, supported methods, or fiat purchase fulfillment.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already revises the FAQ to remove Big Block references and explain the new $5/$5/$5 primary-mint allocation.
The decision changes prize types and revenue allocation but does not change wallet provisioning, asset custody, purchase confirmation, or reward-access behavior.
The Big Block removal and revenue reallocation do not affect optional tipping behavior or its configured tip amounts.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the About-page mechanics copy with Small Block-only tickets and prizes while removing Big Block descriptions.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $5 primary-mint contribution to the continuing Small Block prize pool; the remaining Small Block rules stay valid.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows ticket issuance and counters to Small Block and removes both obsolete Big Block lifecycle keys.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the mission-page prize copy with continuing Small Block prizes and explicitly excludes Big Block advertising.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block eligibility from the selection state and narrows scope to Small Block while preserving Chainlink VRF selection.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket from the no-referral reward components while retaining the $5 commission and Small Block ticket.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already deletes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute from NFT metadata state.
